text:
liz (Design): sketching a pared-down org settings page focusing on RBAC: compact roles matrix, streamlined invite modal, clear SSO enforcement toggle, and audit log breadcrumbs. sharing Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/rw-rbac-v3-sketch 

omar (PM): love the compactness. main priorities: make it obvious who can do billing/key ops, reduce accidental full-access invites, and make audit events findable.

frank_front (Frontend): suggestion: collapse permissions into three states per cell: None / View / Manage. use a small select inside each cell to avoid many toggles. that helps keyboard nav too.

rachel_sec (Security): must clarify semantics: "View" on keys should not return raw secret values via API. show a tooltip: `View = metadata only; Manage = create/regenerate/export` and reflect that in audit entries.

liz (Design): added inline badges for critical perms (Billing, Keys, Admin) and a hover explanation. moving SSO toggle into the top-right of org settings with a small secondary link "What changes when SSO is on". copy draft: "Enabling SSO enforces SAML/OIDC logins; existing non-SSO invites will be disabled if 'Enforce SSO' is checked."

tess_ops (EngOps): for audit log nav: propose the left-hand mini-filter bar with quick filters (actor, action, resource), a date quick-range (last 24h / 7d / 30d) and a server-side cursor for paging. avoid loading >200 events client-side.

frank_front (Frontend): accessibility checklist: ensure select controls are reachable by keyboard, provide aria-label for each permission cell like `role_name can manage billing`. color is not the only affordance (icons + text). Also ensure modal trap focus and ESC closes it.

omar (PM): invite flow tweak: default role = org default, but show a small, prominent "Restrict to view-only" toggle in the modal. also change button copy to a single clear action: "Send Invite". any objections?

rachel_sec (Security): add warning banner if invite email domain differs from org allowed domains. also require org-admin confirmation when granting Billing or Key Manager roles.

liz (Design): updated mock: modal has role dropdown, a checkbox "Enforce view-only" and a subtle note: "API key creation requires Key Manager role." also added a CSV import button on the roles page for bulk upload.

tess_ops (EngOps): backend requirements for import/export: CSV with columns: role_id, name, perms_hex, description. import endpoint must be idempotent with `client_request_id`. example payload: 
```
POST /api/orgs/:org_id/roles/import
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "client_request_id": "uuid-1234",
  "roles_csv_url": "https://s3.amazonaws.com/.../roles.csv"
}
```

frank_front (Frontend): small UI flow: when a user clicks a role row, open an inline drawer (not full page) with a diff view and save/cancel. helps to keep context when checking multiple roles. keyboard navigation: `Enter` to open drawer, `Esc` to close.

rachel_sec (Security): audit log detail: record {actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, before_bits, after_bits, ip, user_agent, timestamp}. plus a human-readable summary for the UI. ensure SSO toggle flips emit an audit event and only org-admins can flip it.

liz (Design): accessibility notes added to Figma: live regions for permission changes, focus order top-to-bottom for matrix, aria-describedby for help text, and high-contrast mode checks. link: https://www.figma.com/file/rw-rbac-v3-sketch?node-id=1%3A2

omar (PM): rollout: behind feature-flag `ui.rbac.v3`. alpha to internal, beta to two enterprise customers, then GA. we should emit telemetry when an admin changes permissions and when invites are sent.

tess_ops (EngOps): will provide API spec and example events. also flag: export CSV might contain perms_hex; ensure we redact secret tokens and never include key material.

frank_front (Frontend): responsive: matrix collapses to an accordion on small screens — show role title and a compact list of critical perms with a "See all" action.

liz (Design): thanks — i've added the accordion frame and updated copy for the invite modal. can people react with :eyes: if they reviewed or :thumbsup: to move to tickets?

ux-bot: created ticket RED-UI-489: "RBAC & Org Settings UX overhaul - v3" and attached Figma.

omar (PM): :thumbsup: moving to create JIRA tasks. rachel, can you draft the security checklist for org-admin gating?

rachel_sec (Security): yes, will post in #eng-security by EOD with required audit checks and gating rules.

tess_ops (EngOps): i'll draft the import/export API and basic rate limits.

frank_front (Frontend): one last note: let's add unit tests for keyboard nav around the matrix cells — i can pick that up in the frontend ticket.

liz (Design): appreciated. wrapping up the Figma frames and adding a short test script for accessibility QA. thanks all! :raised_hands:
